children.game_version: The 'Dancing Game' version: use simplified lyrics like 'Heel and toe, away we go' to cue movements.

avoid: Long periods of standing without movement
seniors.counts: Use clear 1-2-3-4 walking counts for every figure.
seniors.seated_version: Dancers sit in two rows; perform 'forward and back' by leaning and 'turns' by circling arms with a partner.
seniors.standing_version: Reduce the 'reel' to a simple walk-through without spinning to maintain balance.
seniors.tempo_and_range: Slow the music to 80-90 BPM; reduce the length of the set to 4 couples to minimize walking distance.

movement_profile.arms_and_hands: Hands joined at shoulder height for turns; arms crossed for do-si-do; linked elbows for the reel
movement_profile.footwork: Walking steps or a light 'bounce' step; sashay (side-slip and close) for the center travel
movement_profile.formation_and_space: Two facing lines (longways set); movement occurs in the 'aisle' between lines and behind the lines during the march
movement_profile.hips_and_torso: Stable torso with movement generated from the legs and feet
movement_profile.levels_and_jumps: No jumps; levels remain constant with a rhythmic bounce
movement_profile.partnering: Frequent partner interaction interspersed with 'reeling' through the rest of the group
movement_profile.posture: Upright and alert, ready for quick directional changes

signature_moves.description: Head couple links right arms for a 1.5 turn, then left arm to the next person in the opposite line.
signature_moves.name: The Reel

signature_moves.description: Dancers pass right shoulders and move around each other back-to-back without turning.
signature_moves.name: Do-si-do

movement_profile.what_to_avoid: Avoid 'running' or 'scrambling'; maintain the 'refined jollity' and geometric precision of the figures.

music_profile.rhythm_pattern: Continuous eighth notes with strong downbeats
music_profile.sound_description: A driving, upbeat fiddle-led sound characterized by rapid-fire melodic lines and a steady, percussive accompaniment that emphasizes the 'bounce' of the dance.
music_profile.vocal_style: Usually instrumental; occasionally accompanied by rhythmic calls

basic_steps: Forward and back (4 steps each way)
Two-hand turn (join hands and rotate once)
Sashay/Chasse (side-slip down the center and back)
The Reel (alternate arm swings with partner and line members)
The March (turn outward and file to the foot)
The Arch (head couple forms a gate for others to pass through)
teaching.formation: Longways set (two parallel lines of 5-8 couples)
teaching.level_notes: Beginners should focus on the 'reel' timing, ensuring they return to the center to swing their partner between every side-line swing.
teaching.rhythm: Quick 2/4 or 6/8 time with a bounce
